description: Estimation du niveau de fréquentation maximale par ligne de bus STAR pour la semaine en cours is a dataset listed in STAR Data Explore open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by STAR. Estimation du niveau de fréquentation maximale par ligne STAR pour la semaine en cours Les données produites dans ce jeu de données correspondent à des estimations et des projections de niveau de fréquentation maximale par ligne STAR pour la semaine en cours. Coverage: Rennes Métropole (STAR network). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements, Navitia. Its keywords are charge, fréquentation. The portal shows 90,020 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2022-02-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-explore-star-fr-portal.
